label: Axis arrow
notes: WAR ROOM plans (owner 2026-10-07, spec 2026-10-07-war-room-annotations-and-planning-pieces §2.1): NATO's axis of advance as a broad crayon band widening to a filled head, its tail notched like a pennon. gesture: path (press-drag-release), ring (a compass from the centre), loop (a closed lasso), point (a click). pen 1: drawn as sepia ink, not crayon, and the pen is its default stick. cut: the build the kind came with (2 = the second cut, no slot yet)

label: Front line
notes: a fortified line: a thick crayon line with saw teeth on the side it faces (the drawer's left by default; Flip the teeth moves them)

label: Phase line
notes: a dashed pen line lettered at both ends

label: Objective
notes: a double ring lettered in small capitals

label: Area
notes: an assembly area: a crayon outline hatched across
